scope: Typed read-only P1CDI query API/CLI, evidence-preserving Research Console producer projections/source-admission evidence, and System Atlas reference-only deep-link bindings
acceptance: all query outputs bind exact source frontier, assessment/profile generation, currentness, visibility, completeness, warnings and reason trace
HISTORY and AS_OF preserve append-only first-valid semantics without hindsight
EVIDENCE, CONTRADICTIONS and NULLS remain distinct and no scalar support score is synthesized
optimized SEARCH remains reference-equivalent and fails closed on index corruption or divergence
protected material never enters search, counts, aggregates or consumer projections
NEXT_DISCOVERY_WORK remains advisory-only with no actuator reachability
Research Console projection preserves the producer envelope, has no write controls, and does not self-admit P1CDI
System Atlas references remain deep links only and cannot mutate or recompute P1CDI truth
rollback: Forward-revert WP9 only; preserve WP8 physical materialisation and all prior immutable evidence.
